issues.display_title: Issue #228: Integrate Windows CLI Engine (pano.exe) for 360 Stitching Pipeline
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

Integrate the new Windows-compatible stitching CLI executable (pano.exe) into the desktop app processing engine, orchestrating both the project file generation (create) and final panorama export (render).
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yiwjjlpigrnKMJzNur7qaih5fA--7KY7/view?usp=sharing

new version
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sNtGjdTJV4L2QRI02VQ-kWrJOqAfqgZb/view?usp=sharing

& "K:\Projects\panorama-stitcher\dist\pano\pano.exe" create "K:\Work\GoThru\2026\09\09\3585564\pano\enfuse\IMG_0853-IMG_0855.jpg"
     "K:\Work\GoThru\2026\09\09\3585564\pano\enfuse\IMG_0856-IMG_0858.jpg" "K:\Work\GoThru\2026\09\09\3585564\pano\enfuse\IMG_0859-IMG_0861.jpg"
     "K:\Work\GoThru\2026\09\09\3585564\pano\enfuse\IMG_0862-IMG_0864.jpg" --output "K:\Work\GoThru\2026\09\09\3585564\pano\enfuse\3585564-gpu.pts"
     --exposure optimize 

& "K:\Projects\panorama-stitcher\dist\pano\pano.exe" render "K:\Work\GoThru\2026\09\09\3585564\pano\enfuse\3585564-gpu.pts"
     "K:\Work\GoThru\2026\09\09\3585564\pano\enfuse\3585564-gpu-8192.jpg" --width 8192
     --height 4096 --blend multiband
     --backend gpu-multiband-experimental --coordinate-geometry gpu-experimental
     --sampling mipmap `
     --photometric auto
